label: EXTRACT()
description: Extract a date or time field

uses.title: Compare hot and cold months
uses.snippet:
average_completion_time,
            EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month_num,
            EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year_num
        FROM honeycomb_game

uses.title: Count a player’s closest interactions
uses.snippet:
type,
			  EXTRACT(DAY FROM date) AS day,
			  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM date) AS month,
			  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year
